Found it. The error buried in all that output was on line 599: `ReferenceError: retries is not defined` in src/core/settings.js. On line 17, the code was referencing an undefined variable `retries` instead of the parameter `env.retries`. Fixed it by changing that line to use the environment value with a fallback default.

Build passes clean now — 3 warnings, 0 errors, exit code 0.
